features.name: Project skeleton + types + config
features.notes: Created layout, pyproject.toml, config/retrieval.yaml, types.py, config.py

features.name: Chunker with provenance
features.notes: Heading-aware splitting, token windows with overlap, stable chunk_ids. 6 tests pass.

features.name: Corpus + ingest
features.notes: 8 docs created (34 chunks total), ingest writes data/chunks.jsonl

features.name: BM25 index
features.notes: Pure-Python Okapi BM25 with tiktoken. 3 tests pass.

features.name: Dense index
features.notes: sentence-transformers all-MiniLM-L6-v2, cosine similarity. 3 tests pass.

features.name: RRF hybrid + CLI
features.notes: RRF fusion (k=60), CLI table with rank/citation/rrf/bm25/dense/snippet

features.name: Retrieval golden eval
features.notes: 24 golden cases, recall@5: BM25=0.771, Dense=0.917, Hybrid=0.917. Hybrid PASS.

features.name: Shared tokenizer
features.notes: count_tokens() using tiktoken cl100k_base. 3 tokenizer tests pass.

features.name: Packer without retrieval
features.notes: Budget enforcement, must_keep tools, oldest-first memory drops. 19 assembly tests pass.

features.name: Wire retrieve → pack
features.verify_command: python -m contextlab assemble --query 'what does E-4471 mean' --budget 800
features.notes: Retrieval blocks get citation overhead, prompt format: system → retrieval → memory → tools → user

features.name: Drop report + example artifact
features.notes: 3 cases: comfortable (0 drops), tight (2 drops), pathological (1 drop)

features.name: Optional generate flag
features.notes: Flag present, skips if OPENAI_API_KEY not set, requires key to actually generate

features.name: Report schema + runner skeleton
features.notes: EvalReport with suites/gates/cases, run_suite returns (results, metrics), write_latest writes artifacts/eval_report.json

features.name: Assembly suite
features.notes: 7 deterministic invariant checks: under_budget, query_kept, system_kept, citations_resolve, no_dropped_cited, no_empty_keep, negative_retrieval

features.name: Answer golden + deterministic graders
features.notes: 14 answer cases, graders: citation_support, required_facts, forbidden_facts, refusal_on_missing. Offline mode skips fact checks without failing.

features.name: Gates + mutation experiment
features.notes: gates.yaml declares thresholds; BM25-only mutation (hybrid_k=0) fails paraphrase gate (0.000 < 0.60). Default config passes all gates.

features.name: Judge path (optional)
features.notes: Rubric in evals/rubrics/answer_v1.md, judge_grader in graders.py, structured output {score, passed, reason}, threshold ≥ 2. Skips gracefully when key absent.

features.name: Tracer + in-memory exporter
features.notes: src/contextlab/trace/tracer.py: start_trace/start_span, contextvar current span, nested spans get parent_span_id, secrets.token_hex ids (32/16 hex). InMemoryExporter for tests.

features.name: JSONL export + show CLI
features.verify_command: python -m contextlab assemble --query 'what does E-4471 mean' --budget 800 && python -m contextlab.trace show --last
features.notes: One JSON object per span per line in data/traces/YYYYMMDD.jsonl; trace show --last/--trace/--case prints summary + indented tree (durations, status, chunk/dropped ids); trace list

features.name: Instrument retrieve + assemble
features.notes: Spans retrieve.<mode> + retrieve.bm25/dense/fuse + assemble.pack; chunk_ids on the retrieve span equals the Hit list; ranking behavior unchanged; trace_id wired onto settings

features.name: Instrument eval runner
features.verify_command: python -m contextlab.evals run --suite all --offline && python -m contextlab.trace show --case r001
features.notes: One eval.case trace per case; CaseResult.trace_id in artifacts/eval_report.json; --case resolves the latest trace whose eval.case case_id matches

features.name: Redaction + README
features.notes: redact_keys matched per key segment so prompt_tokens/input_tokens stay readable; value scrub for sk-/Bearer/key=secret; README tracing section + missing_context flagging

features.name: Signals + policy + dry-run CLI
features.notes: router/signals.py (identifier regex, keyword intent_hint, conflict) + router/policy.py (first-match yaml rules, unknown when-keys fail loud) + python -m contextlab.route --query ... --dry-run

features.name: Router golden set (19 cases)
features.notes: evals/router_golden.jsonl: 4+ identifier->cheap, 3 version + 2 table + 2 paraphrase + 2 conflict->strong, 2 negative->cheap, 1 default. Intent labels must match the shipped policy (intent_accuracy 1.0).

features.name: Trace + assemble hook
features.verify_command: python -m contextlab assemble --query 'what does E-4471 mean' --budget 800 --generate && python -m contextlab.trace show --last
features.notes: router.decide span (route, model, reason, intent_hint, has_identifier, dry_run) nested under the assemble/eval tree; assemble --generate routes then calls the routed model

features.name: Fallback
features.notes: generate.py retries once with models.fallback when the primary raises: span ok with fallback_used=true and primary_error; both failing propagates. Stub client, no key needed.

features.name: Cost fields (no invented numbers)
features.notes: prices_usd_per_1m null -> cost_usd_estimate omitted (never 0.0); flat number or {input, output} split when filled in

features.name: Fingerprint + exact cache
features.notes: cache/fingerprint.py (corpus_version from data/chunks.jsonl, retrieve_mode, budget_tokens, system_hash, route/model) + normalized-query exact layer; a fingerprint mismatch is a miss even for identical text

features.name: Semantic lookup + guards
features.notes: cosine over stored query embeddings (same sentence-transformers stack as dense retrieval); guards for identifiers, numbers, mid-sentence capitalized entities and version-word groups. Guards default ON: an empty guards:{} does not disable them.

features.name: Cache golden set (14) + gates
features.notes: evals/cache_golden.jsonl: 8 should_hit (5 paraphrases + 2 exact + 1 hard paraphrase at 0.54), 6 must_miss (old-vs-current, E-4471-vs-E-4472, region, plan, mode, budget). Measured: should_hit_rate 0.875, false_hit_rate 0.000; gates 0.80 / 0.00

features.name: Wire into the answer path + traces
features.verify_command: python -m contextlab.cache lookup --query 'What does E-4471 mean?' && python -m contextlab.trace show --last
features.notes: cache/answer.py: assemble -> route -> cache.lookup -> hit? stored answer : generate -> cache.write. cache.lookup/cache.write spans with hit/score/reason/cache_id. A hit skips generation and the write.

features.name: Mutation note
features.verify_command: python -m contextlab.evals run --suite cache --offline  # with require_fingerprint: false
features.notes: Recorded in progress.md: threshold 0.99 -> should_hit 0.250 (FAIL); require_fingerprint:false -> false_hit 0.333 (FAIL, c011+c012); guards off at 0.50 -> false_hit 0.667 (c008,c009,c010,c014)
